boatCaptured: {boatName}, as recorded at the departure roll call, {date}
boatNoNotices: The papers and the gear register showed nothing lapsed or missing.
boatNoticesLabel: What the papers and the gear register showed at the departure roll call
boatChecklistLabel: What the crew had checked at the departure roll call
boatChecklistCount: {total, plural, one {{checked} of # pre-departure line checked} other {{checked} of # pre-departure lines checked}}
boatChecklistUnchecked: Not checked at the roll call
boatChecklistNone: The shop had no pre-departure checklist at the roll call.
boatChanged: The departure now names another boat or none. This record still describes {boatName}.
boatNotKept: No record of the boat’s papers and safety kit was kept for this departure.
buddyPairedByUnknown: Recorder and time not on record
certSelfDeclaredTag: self-declared by the diver, never verified
checklistEmpty: This shop has no pre-departure checklist defined.
crewNone: No crew was assigned to this departure.
evidenceDescription: Certification records as held when this document was generated, with review dates. Waiver status only; medical answers are never part of this document.
executedDiveDescription: What the crew recorded after each dive, including an explicit absence where a field was not captured.
executedDiveEmpty: No post-dive record has been saved.
footerHashExplainer: Computed from this document’s recorded facts. Re-generating from unchanged records reproduces the same code, so two copies can be checked against each other.
medicalNotClearedRecordedBy: Physician evaluation recorded {date} by {name} as not cleared; evaluation dated {evaluatedOn}. The medical hold stands.
medicalNotClearedRecorded: Physician evaluation recorded {date} as not cleared; evaluation dated {evaluatedOn}. The medical hold stands.
medicalClearanceRecordedBy: Physician clearance recorded {date} by {name}; evaluation dated {evaluatedOn}.
identityWithheld: Identity not confirmed, so details are withheld
ownerOnlyNotice: Only an owner can generate a departure’s log. Everything it draws on (roll call, timeline, each diver’s status) is on that departure’s manifest.
rosterDescription: Every booking the boat counted, with its result at each checkpoint. A seat turned away at the desk is named on its own line and counted nowhere. “Awaiting roll call” means no result was recorded; an absence is stated, never left blank. Buddy team is the grouping recorded for this departure, not per dive; a blank is not a statement that anyone dived alone.
timelineDescription: Every roll-call entry for this departure, and every change to its seats or crew from when the boat was due out (its scheduled start, or the first departure roll call if earlier), oldest first. Entries are append-only, so a correction adds a line and never rewrites one.
timelineEmpty: No roll-call entries have been recorded for this departure.
title: Departure log
waiverCompleteAttested: Recorded by staff from an in-person signature.
waiverCompleteImported: Imported acceptance from a prior system, not signed through this shop’s own release.
waiverMedicalReview: Medical review flagged as required. Status only; the questionnaire’s answers are not part of this document.
waiverNotSigned: No current signed waiver on record.
waiverPaperMarkedBy: Recorded by {name} from an in-person signature.
waiverPending: A waiver link was issued and has not been signed.
timelineSeatMovedHere: Seat moved here from another departure
timelineSeatTurnedAway: Turned away at the desk: {reason, select, medical {medical} waiver {waiver} card {card} age {age} identity {identity} payment {payment} other {not ready}}
timelineErased: A line erased at a person’s request
reportsDescription: The reports on this departure and where each stands. What they say stays on each report.
reportsEmpty: No incident report has been started for this departure.
reportUnsorted: Kind and severity not stated yet
reportDraft: Draft not filed, started by {name} on {date}.
reportDeleted: Draft started by {creator}, deleted unfiled by {name} on {date}.
reportAddenda: {count, plural, =0 {No later notes} one {# later note} other {# later notes}}
sailedWithSnagsHeading: Open on the boat when it sailed
preamble: What was recorded for this departure, as one document: boarding, the roll-call timeline, certification evidence and waiver status. It reports recorded facts with their timestamps and does not assess, certify or imply any safety judgment. Generated in DiveDay {date} by {name}. All times are shop-local ({timezone}).
evidenceWaiverHeaderRecordedBy: {title}, version {version}, recorded by {name} from in-person signatures
evidenceWaiverHeaderAttested: {title}, version {version}, recorded by staff from in-person signatures
evidenceWaiverHeaderImported: {title}, version {version}, imported from a prior system, not signed through this shop’s own release
